title: David Heinemeier Hansson: Microservices vs. Monolith
summary: DHH: microservices are an organizational pattern for thousands of developers; teams of tens to a hundred pay a complexity tax for a context they do not have, so keep the majestic monolith.

assertions.quote: microservices is a pattern that is about organizational structure much more than it is about how to organize your code
you are paying a heavy complex city tax for an environment and a context that just doesn't exist in your organization
apply them to companies of 5 10 or 100 developers you very often get really poor results
